verses.original: הֶן־ כֹּ֭ל רָאֲתָ֣ה עֵינִ֑י שָֽׁמְעָ֥ה אָ֝זְנִ֗י וַתָּ֥בֶן לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hen- kōl rā·’ă·ṯāh ‘ê·nî šā·mə·‘āh ’ā·zə·nî wat·tā·ḇen lāh
verses.literal: Indeed my eyes have seen all this my ears have heard and understood

verses.original: כְּֽ֭דַעְתְּכֶם יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם־ אָ֑נִי לֹא־ נֹפֵ֖ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḏa‘·tə·ḵem yā·ḏa‘·tî ḡam- ’ā·nî lō- nō·p̄êl ’ā·nō·ḵî mik·kem
verses.literal: What you know I also know I am not inferior to you

verses.original: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶל־ שַׁדַּ֣י אֲדַבֵּ֑ר וְהוֹכֵ֖חַ אֶל־ אֵ֣ל אֶחְפָּֽץ׃
verses.literal: Yet I desire to speak to the Almighty and argue my case before God

verses.original: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם טֹֽפְלֵי־ שָׁ֑קֶר רֹפְאֵ֖י אֱלִ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם׃
verses.literal: You however smear with lies you are all worthless physicians

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִ֭תֵּן הַחֲרֵ֣שׁ תַּחֲרִישׁ֑וּן וּתְהִ֖י לָכֶ֣ם לְחָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yit·tên ha·ḥă·rêš ta·ḥă·rî·šūn ū·ṯə·hî lā·ḵem lə·ḥā·ḵə·māh
verses.literal: If only . . . you would remain silent . . . for that would be your wisdom

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֥א תוֹכַחְתִּ֑י וְרִב֖וֹת שְׂפָתַ֣י הַקְשִֽׁיבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- nā ṯō·w·ḵaḥ·tî wə·ri·ḇō·wṯ śə·p̄ā·ṯay haq·šî·ḇū
verses.literal: Hear now my argument and listen to the plea of my lips

verses.original: הַ֭לְאֵל תְּדַבְּר֣וּ עַוְלָ֑ה וְ֝ל֗וֹ תְּֽדַבְּר֥וּ רְמִיָּֽה׃
verses.literal: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf or speak deceitfully for Him

verses.original: הֲפָנָ֥יו תִּשָּׂא֑וּן אִם־ לָאֵ֥ל תְּרִיבֽוּן׃
verses.literal: Would you show Him partiality . . . or argue in His defense

verses.original: הֲ֭טוֹב כִּֽי־ יַחְקֹ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־ כְּהָתֵ֥ל בֶּ֝אֱנ֗וֹשׁ תְּהָתֵ֥לּוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·ṭō·wḇ kî- yaḥ·qōr ’eṯ·ḵem ’im- kə·hā·ṯêl be·’ĕ·nō·wōš tə·hā·ṯêl·lū ḇōw
verses.literal: Would it be well when He examined you - Could you deceive Him as you would deceive a man

verses.original: הוֹכֵ֣חַ יוֹכִ֣יחַ אֶתְכֶ֑ם אִם־ בַּ֝סֵּ֗תֶר פָּנִ֥ים תִּשָּׂאֽוּן׃
verses.literal: Surely He would rebuke . . . you if you secretly showed partiality . . .

verses.original: הֲלֹ֣א שְׂ֭אֵתוֹ תְּבַעֵ֣ת אֶתְכֶ֑ם וּ֝פַחְדּ֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.literal: Would His majesty not terrify you Would the dread of Him not fall upon you

verses.original: זִֽ֭כְרֹנֵיכֶם מִשְׁלֵי־ אֵ֑פֶר לְגַבֵּי־ חֹ֝֗מֶר גַּבֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.literal: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes your defenses are defenses of clay

verses.original: הַחֲרִ֣ישׁוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי וַאֲדַבְּרָה־ אָ֑נִי וְיַעֲבֹ֖ר עָלַ֣י מָֽה׃
verses.literal: Be silent . . . and I will speak Then let come to me what may

verses.original: עַל־ מָ֤ה׀ אֶשָּׂ֣א בְשָׂרִ֣י בְשִׁנָּ֑י וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י אָשִׂ֥ים בְּכַפִּֽי׃
verses.literal: Why . . . do I put myself at risk . . . and take my life in my own hands

verses.original: הֵ֣ן יִ֭קְטְלֵנִי לֹא אֲיַחֵ֑ל אַךְ־ דְּ֝רָכַ֗י אֶל־ פָּנָ֥יו אוֹכִֽיחַ׃
verses.literal: Though He slay me . . . I will hope in Him I will still defend my ways to His face

verses.original: גַּם־ הוּא־ לִ֥י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה כִּי־ לֹ֥א לְ֝פָנָ֗יו חָנֵ֥ף יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: gam- hū- lî lî·šū·‘āh kî- lō lə·p̄ā·nāw ḥā·nêp̄ yā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: Moreover this will be my salvation for no godless man can appear before Him

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ שָׁ֭מוֹעַ מִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝אַֽחֲוָתִ֗י בְּאָזְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.literal: Listen carefully . . . to my words let my declaration ring in your ears

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ נָ֭א עָרַ֣כְתִּי מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יָ֝דַ֗עְתִּי כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י אֶצְדָּֽק׃
verses.literal: See now I have prepared my case I know that I will be vindicated

verses.original: מִי־ ה֭וּא יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֖ה אַחֲרִ֣ישׁ וְאֶגְוָֽע׃
verses.literal: Can anyone . . . indict me If so I will be silent and die

verses.original: אַךְ־ שְׁ֭תַּיִם אַל־ תַּ֣עַשׂ עִמָּדִ֑י אָ֥ז מִ֝פָּנֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א אֶסָּתֵֽר׃
verses.literal: Only grant these two . . . things to me so that I need not hide from You

verses.original: כַּ֭פְּךָ מֵעָלַ֣י הַרְחַ֑ק וְ֝אֵ֥מָתְךָ֗ אַֽל־ תְּבַעֲתַֽנִּי׃
verses.literal: Withdraw Your hand from me and do not let Your terror frighten me

verses.original: וּ֭קְרָא וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶֽעֱנֶ֑ה אֽוֹ־ אֲ֝דַבֵּ֗ר וַהֲשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.literal: Then call me and I will answer or let me speak and You can reply

verses.original: כַּמָּ֣ה לִ֭י עֲוֺנ֣וֹת וְחַטָּא֑וֹת פִּֽשְׁעִ֥י וְ֝חַטָּאתִ֗י הֹדִיעֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: kam·māh lî ‘ă·wō·nō·wṯ wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’ō·wṯ piš·‘î wə·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî hō·ḏî·‘ê·nî
verses.literal: How many are my iniquities and sins Reveal to me my transgression and sin

verses.original: לָֽמָּה־ פָנֶ֥יךָ תַסְתִּ֑יר וְתַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאוֹיֵ֣ב לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- p̄ā·ne·ḵā ṯas·tîr wə·ṯaḥ·šə·ḇê·nî lə·’ō·w·yêḇ lāḵ
verses.literal: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy

verses.original: הֶעָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֣ף תַּעֲר֑וֹץ וְאֶת־ קַ֖שׁ יָבֵ֣שׁ תִּרְדֹּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: he·‘ā·leh nid·dāp̄ ta·‘ă·rō·wṣ wə·’eṯ- qaš yā·ḇêš tir·dōp̄
verses.literal: Would You frighten a windblown leaf Would You chase after dry chaff

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תִכְתֹּ֣ב עָלַ֣י מְרֹר֑וֹת וְ֝תוֹרִישֵׁ֗נִי עֲוֺנ֥וֹת נְעוּרָֽי׃
verses.literal: For You record bitter accusations against me and bequeath to me the iniquities of my youth

verses.original: וְתָ֘שֵׂ֤ם בַּסַּ֨ד׀ רַגְלַ֗י וְתִשְׁמ֥וֹר כָּל־ אָרְחוֹתָ֑י עַל־ שָׁרְשֵׁ֥י רַ֝גְלַ֗י תִּתְחַקֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·śêm bas·saḏ raḡ·lay wə·ṯiš·mō·wr kāl- ’ā·rə·ḥō·w·ṯāy ‘al- šā·rə·šê raḡ·lay tiṯ·ḥaq·qeh
verses.literal: You put my feet in the stocks and stand watch over all my paths You set a limit for the soles of my feet

verses.original: וְ֭הוּא כְּרָקָ֣ב יִבְלֶ֑ה כְּ֝בֶ֗גֶד אֲכָ֣לוֹ עָֽשׁ׃
verses.literal: So man wastes away like something rotten like a moth-eaten . . . garment
